changes.before: 摘要：小时级骨干网络流量预测需要同时刻画短期波动与长期趋势。针对这一需求，设计一种轻量自适应多尺度预测模型。历史窗口数据按三种时间分辨率输入模型，由独立分解线性专家分别生成预测结果。路由网络从当前窗口提取均值、标准差、末时刻均值和平均绝对一阶差分，再由多层感知器计算融合权重。实验采用Abilene和GÉANT，以 96 步历史输入预测未来 24 步。在3个共同随机种子的比较中，单尺度分解线性模型作为对照，本文方法的均方误差分别降低4.07%和4.54%；采样导向轻量模型LightTS作为对照时，降幅为29.80%和46.89%。8种子消融实验以全局可学习权重和恒定输入路由作对照，Abilene的逐种子平均改进率均约为1.80%，GÉANT的对应改进率分别为4.31%和4.97%。多尺度候选预测与低维路由机制配合，在仅引入少量融合参数的条件下获得更低的平均预测误差。输出结果可为次日网络流量需求分析与容量规划提供参考。

changes.before: Abstract: Hourly backbone network traffic forecasting requires a representation of both short-term fluctuations and long-term trends. A lightweight adaptive multiscale forecasting model was developed for this purpose. Three temporal resolutions were used to represent historical windows; at each resolution, independent decomposition linear experts generated candidate forecasts. For the current window, a routing network extracted four statistics: the mean, standard deviation, mean at the last time step, and mean absolute first difference. These statistics served as inputs to a multilayer perceptron with two fully connected layers, which calculated fusion weights. On Abilene and GÉANT, experiments used 96 historical steps for predicting the next 24 steps. With three common random seeds, the proposed method reduced mean squared error by 4.07% and 4.54% relative to the single-scale decomposition linear model, respectively. Relative to the sampling-oriented lightweight model LightTS, the corresponding reductions were 29.80% and 46.89%. In ablation experiments across eight random seeds, learned global weights and a constant-input router served as controls for the proposed method. Against both controls, the mean seed-wise improvements on Abilene were approximately 1.80%; on GÉANT, the respective improvements were 4.31% and 4.97%. Lower mean forecasting errors were obtained by combining multiscale candidate forecasts with low-dimensional routing while adding few additional fusion parameters. For next-day network traffic demand analysis and capacity planning, the forecasts can serve as a reference.
